authoring_note: Hand-authored by collector collect-flora-trees-shrubs from the sources in sources.json (2026-09-26). Months are modern (Gregorian) values as printed by the cited source, mostly for central European Russia; they are mapped to game seasons by scripts/build.mjs. Uses and hazards restate the cited source; quality words (primary/good/occasional/poor) restate the source's qualitative wording, never measured values. Empty name_old_ru = no attested Old Russian form was checked (gap), not an absence.
